$comment: #1379 — recorded HIGH/CRITICAL findings in the container images that have NO fix yet.
Read by scripts/lib/image-scan-gate.mjs (ci.yml `api`, build-images.yml). Policy, in short:
a fixable HIGH/CRITICAL always fails unless its entry sets allowFixed; an unfixed CRITICAL
fails unless recorded here; an unfixed HIGH not recorded here is a warning; and an entry
whose `expires` date has passed FAILS the gate while its finding is still present.
`expires` is a REVIEW date: on it, check whether the distro has shipped a fix. If it has,
rebuild (the images apply distro updates at build time) and MOVE the entry to `expired`;
if not, re-date it deliberately. Never re-date only to clear a red build.
An entry never simply disappears: any finding matching an id in `expired` FAILS, and on a
pull request a waiver deleted from `waivers` (and not moved to `expired`) FAILS while its
finding is present. So removing the record is never a way to turn a red build green.
Fields: id (CVE/GHSA), expires (a real YYYY-MM-DD date), reason, images (optional list of
image labels: server, ui, embeddings-svc, sql-lineage; absent = all), allowFixed (optional,
for a fix that exists but cannot be installed yet — keep that window short).
An empty `waivers` list is the goal.

waivers.reason: util-linux (bsdutils, libblkid1, libmount1, libsmartcols1, libuuid1, liblastlog2-2, login, mount): no fix in Debian trixie on 2026-10-21. Mount-helper privilege issue; the containers run as uid 1001 with no CAP_SYS_ADMIN and never mount.
util-linux: no fix in Debian trixie on 2026-10-21. nsenter --join-cgroup; nothing in the images runs nsenter, and the containers run as uid 1001.
util-linux: no fix in Debian trixie on 2026-10-21. X-mount.subdir resolution; the containers never mount and hold no mount capability.
util-linux: no fix in Debian trixie on 2026-10-21. Restricted bind mounts; the containers never mount and hold no mount capability.

ncurses (libtinfo6, libncursesw6, ncurses-base, ncurses-bin): no fix in Debian trixie on 2026-10-21. Terminal-database parsing; the services run no curses program and read no attacker-supplied terminfo.

systemd (libsystemd0, libudev1): no fix in Debian trixie on 2026-10-21. systemd-homed local privilege escalation; homed is not installed or running in the containers, only the client libraries are present.
acl (libacl1): no fix in Debian trixie on 2026-10-21. Symlink traversal via libacl functions in a privileged caller; nothing in the images calls libacl as root.
